name: STSD
description: A large-scale annotated point-cloud dataset of subway tunnels for evaluating semantic segmentation methods on tunnel environments.
reputation: Niche, domain-specific dataset with limited but growing use in research on tunnel and underground environment perception.
notes: Non-LLM, point-cloud semantic segmentation benchmark; domain-specific (subway tunnels) with potential class imbalance and sensor/capture-specific biases; moderate dataset size but limited community saturation.
